title: Fix Lowpoly Dev Infinite Loop
description: Fix lowpoly dev Maximum update depth exceeded infinite React loop.
summary:
Fixed lowpoly dev crash (Maximum update depth exceeded) caused by an infinite notify/re-render loop.

- Removed `selectedIds`/`selectionMode` from fixture reload effect deps in LowpolyCanvas; selection sync uses a dedicated effect keyed by id fingerprint.
- Memoized `selectedIds` in LowpolyPlaySurfaceHost via `interactionRevision`.
- Split session bridge: fixture reload notifies tessellation; selection-only changes sync WASM without re-tessellating.
- Removed spurious `notifyLowpolySharedPlay()` on session init when session already exists.
